name: audit-standard-tool-library

expectations.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
expectations.evidence: The reply orders the work as 'Fix first: these break reservations' (items 1 to 5, before launch), then 'Fix next', 'Smaller issues' and a 'Suggested order'. Under 'What I inferred' it says it 'didn't run VoiceOver or TalkBack', so the screen-reader points come from the markup, and leaves 'one pass on a real iPhone with VoiceOver and larger text turned on' to a person.

expectations.text: No fixture source file was modified

not_applicable: The run is standard depth with three isolated heuristic evaluators
The critical journeys were walked and the records validate
Verification and three blind ratings exist
Recall of the seeded defects is at least 0.6
Precision after verification is at least 0.8
Severity ratings land in the expected bands for most matched defects
Report language passes the lint and the level is not overstated

grader_mapping.title: Basket hold expires after 10 minutes with no warning and no way back
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R1, B R1). Nothing on the site says the hold lasts ten minutes, and once it lapses Continue shows 'Something went wrong. Try again.', which says neither what happened nor what to do. That is D10's untimed hold and misleading error; 'Trying again fails every time, because the timer is never reset' is the same unhandled lapse.

grader_mapping.title: Pick-up day and pick-up session are chosen separately and can disagree
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R2, B R2). The day chosen on the tool page and the session chosen in the basket are never checked against each other (the basket 'doesn't check it against that day'), and the run ends with the drill listed as 'pick up Saturday 17 October' against the 'Wednesday 21 October' session, so 'The desk can't tell which one is right'. That is D15, down to its own example.

grader_mapping.title: Calendar accepts closed days; refused only on the confirm page with no link back
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R3, B R3). 'Every date can be chosen, including days the library is closed', and the refusal ('The library is closed on Friday 16 October… Choose another day') comes only on the confirm page, with 'no link to the place where you change it'. That is D06.

grader_mapping.title: Days and sessions before the tool's available-from date are accepted
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R4, B R4). The calendar allows 'days before the tool is back' and the basket accepted the 10 Oct session for a pressure washer available from 17 Oct; offering only sessions on or after each tool's 'available from' date fixes D14.

grader_mapping.title: Tapping Confirm twice books the tool twice
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R5, B R5). The Confirm button 'gives no visible sign that it's working for 1.5 s, and it isn't disabled', and tapping it twice gave FT-4471 and FT-4472 for the same drill. That is D12.

grader_mapping.title: Basket not emptied after a confirmed booking
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R6, B R6). 'The basket also isn't emptied after a confirmed booking': the header still showed 'Basket (1)' on the confirmation (done) page. That is D18.

grader_mapping.title: Truncated tool names make the two drills look the same on a phone
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R7, B R7). Names are cut to one line with an ellipsis, so at 375 px both drills read 'Cordless drill 18 V, co…' and the battery difference the journey depends on is hidden. That is D03.

grader_mapping.title: A search with no results silently keeps the old list
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R8, B R8). Searching 'hammer' still shows all 10 tools and 'Screen readers get no announcement', so members cannot tell that nothing matched. That is D02's no-match search with an empty status region.

grader_mapping.title: Dark-mode 'Available from' badge fails text contrast
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R9, B R9). In dark mode the badge is #2f7d4a on #1d2622, 'a contrast of 3.07:1', for bold 16 px text that needs 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3). That is D04.

grader_mapping.title: Faint calendar day borders and selected-day fill in dark mode
grader_mapping.reason: Settled for B (A real-unseeded, B not-a-problem; see settled). The review gives this as one of 'two smaller dark-mode points', with no criterion and no fix, and says the selection still shows: 'The selected day is mostly shown by its 2 px border'. It does not show that a member cannot tell which day is chosen, and the faint borders surround day buttons their numbers already identify, so no harm to members is shown.

grader_mapping.title: Loan-length dropdown shadow does not show in dark mode
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R11, B R11). A shadow is decoration; the review gives no measurement and does not say the open list blends into the page or that any option is hard to read.

grader_mapping.title: On phones search and filters sit below all ten tools behind an icon-only button
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R12, B R12). Below 480 px the stylesheet moves the search form under the results ('about 2,100 px down the page'), 'The filters button is an icon with no visible word', and members 'don't know where the date filter is'. That is D01. The review places the keyboard/visual order mismatch on desktop rather than on phones, but it comes from the same order rules, and dropping them fixes D01.

grader_mapping.title: Basket pick-up sessions shown in reverse order
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R13, B R13). row-reverse with wrap-reverse shows Wed 28 Oct at the top and Sat 10 Oct at the bottom on a phone, while 'Screen readers and the keyboard go through them in date order'. That is D11.

grader_mapping.title: Confirm page rejects ordinary membership-number and mobile formats
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R14, B R14). 'ft-01234', 'FT 01234', 'FT01234', '+44 7700 900123' and '07700 900 123' are all rejected, with no normalising. That is D17.

grader_mapping.title: Loan-length dropdown traps the keyboard and cannot be dismissed
grader_mapping.reason: Settled as one item, as A had it (B split off the outside tap as its R16; see settled). While the list is open 'Tab cycles through the options instead of leaving the control' and 'Escape doesn't close it': D09's keyboard trap. 'Tapping outside doesn't close it either' is the same failure of the open list to let go, on the same control and with the same fix ('replace it with a native <select>'), so fixing what the item describes fixes D09.

grader_mapping.title: Fixed 'Reserve this tool' bar covers the footer and desk phone number
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R16, B R17). Nothing pads the page clear of the fixed bar, so the footer with the desk phone number sits under the 'Reserve this tool' bar 'even when scrolled to the bottom'. That is D08's phone symptom; the review does not mention covered focused day buttons, so it reports the narrower part of the same defect.

grader_mapping.title: 'Added to your basket' vanishes after 1.2 s with no next step nearby
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R17, B R18). 'The message disappears after 1.2 s' and the only way on is the 'Basket (1)' link at the top of the page: brief feedback with nothing lasting nearby. The item does not say members believe the tool is reserved, so under the D07/D26 rule it is D07, not D26.

grader_mapping.title: Tool grid scrolls sideways at 320 px
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R18, B R19). minmax(330px, 1fr) gives '346 px of content in 320 px', so the page scrolls sideways (WCAG 1.4.10). That is D05.

grader_mapping.title: Confirm page 'Change' link drops the chosen session
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R19, B R20). The 'Change' link 'goes to the basket without the current session ticked'. That is D13.

grader_mapping.title: Returning to the confirm page clears the details already typed
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R20, B R21). 'Coming back to confirm also clears the details the member already typed', so the member types them again on a phone. That is D22.

grader_mapping.title: Three-tools-per-member limit not enforced in the basket
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R21, B R22). 'The three-tools-per-member rule isn't enforced in the basket.' That is D21.

grader_mapping.title: Done page reads the tool name twice to screen readers
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R22, B R23). The hidden #c-tool copy makes screen readers read the tool name twice. The review uses 'confirmation page' for the done page throughout (it is also where it saw 'Basket (1)' after confirming), so this is D24.

grader_mapping.title: 'Choose a pick-up session' error link points at a container that cannot take focus
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R23, B R24). Following the error link does not put keyboard or screen-reader members on the session radio buttons, so they have to hunt for the choices the error is about, and many members meet this error because the basket starts with no session selected. Not in the ground truth: D19 is the tool page's day message and D23 is the date being asked for twice.

grader_mapping.title: No 'Skip to content' link on any page
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R24, B R25). The review shows no long repeated block that members must get past (the header it mentions holds the 'Basket (1)' link) and does not say headings or landmarks are missing, so on these short, phone-first pages it is a checklist remark with no harm shown.
